rationale: REFERENCE CLOSE: 7405.50, settled cash close of 23 July 2026 (the last completed session strictly before the report date). PIVOT INPUTS: daily pivots are recomputed from the 23 Jul 2026 cash session H/L/C = 7449.80 / 7375.30 / 7405.50, i.e. P = (7449.80 + 7375.30 + 7405.50)/3 = 7410.20; R1 = 2P - L = 7445.10; S1 = 2P - H = 7370.60; R2 = P + (H - L) = 7484.70; S2 = P - (H - L) = 7335.70; R3 = H + 2(P - L) = 7519.60; S3 = L - 2(H - P) = 7296.10. Because these prior-period extremes come from the corroborated slice record rather than the report's indicative extremes, the tier is computable and corroborated, so the all-tiers-indicative suppression trigger does not fire; the same rebuild also supplies the weekly set from the prior completed week 13-17 Jul 2026 (P 7490.33, R1 7549.07, S1 7397.87), used only as cross-reference. TARGETS from the breakout-side pivot ladder: TP1 = S1 = 7370.60 (35.64 points from entry, inside 2.5xATR = 175.40); TP2 = S1.5 = (S1 + S2)/2 = (7370.60 + 7335.70)/2 = 7353.15; TP3 = S2 = 7335.70.
